fields.supportingExcerpt: Method card, what it measures: cytokines retained inside cells during a defined assay, so a response can be assigned to stained cell populations. How: cells get a defined stimulus, a protein-transport inhibitor is present for a stated window so newly made cytokines accumulate, the cells are fixed and made permeable, and flow cytometry reads cytokine stains beside population markers, with a viability stain applied before fixation. Input: viable blood or tissue cells, with separate aliquots per stimulus, and fixed cells cannot go on to living-cell assays. Output: percent cytokine-positive cells within a named parent population, or percent with stated cytokine combinations. Controls: unstimulated or vehicle, a positive stimulation, viability and recovery, single-stain and staining-boundary controls. It cannot tell natural tumour presentation, direct target-cell killing, receptor sequence identity or clinical benefit.
fields.semanticStatus: Exact current-field anchor; source-to-requirement acceptance remains pending.

fields.supportingExcerpt: Precision evidence: in a study among laboratories involved in HIV clinical trials, using a common protocol and a cytomegalovirus pp65 peptide mix, mean inter-laboratory coefficients of variation ranged from 17% to 44% depending on sample type and analysis method, cryopreserved PBMC gave lower variation than whole blood, and centralised analysis with a dynamic gating template cut it by 5% to 20%. Variation was lowest (18% to 24%) for samples with more than 0.5% interferon gamma positive T cells and highest (57% to 82%) for samples below 0.1%, so gating is a major source of variability and precision falls as the responding frequency falls (Maecker 2005). That study supports protocol and gating consistency and does not validate every panel, stimulus or disease.
fields.semanticStatus: Exact current-field anchor; source-to-requirement acceptance remains pending.

fields.supportingExcerpt: Fictional interpretation: a report finds cells positive for both interferon gamma and tumour necrosis factor after peptide stimulation. They are double-cytokine-positive under that assay and may not be called tumour-killing, because natural tumour recognition and death of appropriate targets need separate tests, and a strong response to a broad positive control confirms assay responsiveness and not recognition of the intended peptide. Polyfunctional means meeting the assay's rules for several measured functions, so it always needs its panel and stimulus attached, and a stained subset can contain many receptors.
fields.semanticStatus: Exact current-field anchor; source-to-requirement acceptance remains pending.

fields.supportingExcerpt: This test labels cells whose receptors bind a particular displayed peptide under the assay conditions. It helps identify a binding population that can then be studied for function.
fields.semanticStatus: Exact current-field anchor; source-to-requirement acceptance remains pending.

fields.supportingExcerpt: The original peptide-MHC tetramer study made soluble multimeric peptide-display complexes to identify antigen-specific T cells. Binding correlated with cytotoxicity in the tested systems, but those observations are different measurements. The chosen peptide and HLA molecule define which interaction is tested. Detecting multimer-binding cells does not by itself establish natural display of that peptide by a tumor, successful target-cell killing or a clinical treatment effect.
fields.semanticStatus: Exact current-field anchor; source-to-requirement acceptance remains pending.

fields.supportingExcerpt: Method card, what it measures: binding of cells to a specified peptide held by a specified HLA allele, under the staining conditions. How: HLA molecules are assembled with the selected peptide and several copies are attached to a labelled scaffold (a tetramer is one format), cells are exposed and analysed, usually by flow cytometry, with viable-cell and gate selection. Input: blood or tissue cells, where staining uses a defined aliquot and compatibility with later living-cell assays depends on the preparation, and the reagent must match both peptide and allele. Thresholds: gate and positivity rules need background and reagent controls, and no universal percentage shows efficacy. Failure modes: nonspecific binding, weak binding, dead cells, a wrong or poorly formed reagent, chain differences or sampling loss. It cannot tell cytokine response, tumour-cell killing, healthy-tissue specificity or benefit.
fields.semanticStatus: Exact current-field anchor; source-to-requirement acceptance remains pending.

fields.supportingExcerpt: Denominators, fictional arithmetic: 100 stained cells among 10,000 gated CD8 T cells is 1%, and the same 100 among 40,000 viable acquired cells is 0.25%. Both are correct and answer different denominator questions, and neither is a body-wide census or a killing rate. A tetramer-negative result is not a census of every possible relevant receptor, because some receptors bind too weakly for a given staining method, and HLA restriction belongs to the peptide-HLA pair and not the peptide alone.
fields.semanticStatus: Exact current-field anchor; source-to-requirement acceptance remains pending.

fields.supportingExcerpt: What the evidence shows: in the original report, tetramers of HLA-A2 with two HIV-derived peptides or an influenza A matrix peptide bound peptide-specific cytotoxic T cells in vitro and T cells from the blood of HIV-infected people, and binding in general correlated well with cytotoxicity assays (Altman 1996). That is a correlation in those systems and not a rule that binding equals killing for an arbitrary tumour peptide. Tetramers are made by mixing biotinylated MHC with fluorescent streptavidin, and a later method made them with small-molecule fluorophores (Ramachandiran 2007), so reagent preparation is a source of variation. An observed stain shows binding under the tested conditions and does not show natural processing and display of that pair by a tumour.
fields.semanticStatus: Exact current-field anchor; source-to-requirement acceptance remains pending.

fields.supportingExcerpt: Connecting assays is an inference task. A multimer-binding cell with no measured cytokine response need not identify one failed biological step: reagent performance, viability, stimulation, measurement window and each assay's threshold can differ. A cytokine response still does not directly measure target-cell death. Compatible cell sorting and receptor sequencing can connect binding to an operational receptor identity, but natural tumour presentation, recognition and killing remain separate questions to test.
fields.semanticStatus: Exact current-field anchor; source-to-requirement acceptance remains pending.

fields.supportingExcerpt: This blood-cell preparation contains lymphocytes and monocytes used in many immune tests. Collection and handling affect which cells and responses can be measured.
fields.semanticStatus: Exact current-field anchor; source-to-requirement acceptance remains pending.

fields.supportingExcerpt: The National Library of Medicine distinguishes mononuclear leukocytes from granulocytes and from monocytes alone. A primary study of immune monitoring in HIV vaccine research found that processing and cryopreservation conditions affected cell recovery, viability and measured antigen responses. Those were assay findings, not a validated cancer-treatment predictor. A blood preparation also samples a different compartment from a tumor biopsy; the specimen and handling conditions belong with its interpretation.
fields.semanticStatus: Exact current-field anchor; source-to-requirement acceptance remains pending.

fields.supportingExcerpt: What the fraction is: peripheral blood mononuclear cells are circulating white blood cells with a single unsegmented nucleus, mainly lymphocytes and monocytes, with T, B and natural killer cells among them, isolated by layering anticoagulated blood over a density-separation medium and collecting the interface. Most conventional granulocytes and red cells separate elsewhere, but recovery is incomplete, so platelets, red cells or low-density granulocytes can contaminate a preparation, and the label PBMC does not guarantee purity. The classic density-gradient method dates from 1968 (Boyum 1968). Isolation selects a recoverable blood fraction and does not sample tumour or give a complete immune census.
fields.semanticStatus: Exact current-field anchor; source-to-requirement acceptance remains pending.

fields.supportingExcerpt: Handling is evidence: in HIV vaccine assay studies, the time from venipuncture to cryopreservation was the most important parameter, and blood processed at 24 hours compared with within 8 hours lost on average about 8% of PBMC viability, about 32% of cell recovery and 36% to 56% of interferon gamma T-cell frequencies by ELISpot, which led the authors to recommend cryopreservation within 8 hours (Bull 2007). That is a finding for those protocols and assays and is not a universal schedule for cancer assays. A rapidly processed baseline and a delayed follow-up can therefore confound a biological comparison, and a high viability percentage alone does not show that every population or function was preserved.
fields.semanticStatus: Exact current-field anchor; source-to-requirement acceptance remains pending.

fields.supportingExcerpt: Preparation card: input is anticoagulated blood or a blood-cell collection product and separation processes that aliquot and retains a selected cell fraction for compatible downstream assays. Output is recovered cell number, viable-cell percentage, recovery after thawing and measured population fractions, with cells per original blood volume needing a documented calculation. Controls are collection and processing timestamps, anticoagulant, storage, counting and viability methods and matched handling across time points. Thresholds are acceptance rules set for the intended downstream assay and not one universal quality number. Fictional case: two tubes have equally high viability but one recovered far fewer monocytes, so they are not automatically interchangeable for a whole-protein stimulation assay, because monocytes can contribute antigen presentation and viability does not show composition.
fields.semanticStatus: Exact current-field anchor; source-to-requirement acceptance remains pending.

fields.supportingExcerpt: Receptor sequencing records the immune-receptor sequences sampled from a population of cells. It can track which sequences are present and how their measured abundance changes.
fields.semanticStatus: Exact current-field anchor; source-to-requirement acceptance remains pending.

fields.supportingExcerpt: An original sequencing study quantified rearranged T-cell receptor beta-chain sequences to examine repertoire diversity. A beta-chain repertoire is a sampled molecular measurement, not a complete map of paired receptors or the antigens they recognize. The specimen, sequencing method and definition of a clonotype belong with the result. Following a sequence over time is distinct from demonstrating its antigen specificity or the function of the cells that carry it.
fields.semanticStatus: Exact current-field anchor; source-to-requirement acceptance remains pending.

fields.supportingExcerpt: Beta match, alpha hidden, fictional: three cells carry beta chains B, B and C, so a bulk beta-chain view lists B, B, C and loses the alpha chains. The paired view keeps alpha X with beta B, alpha Y with beta B and alpha Z with beta C, so the shared beta B does not make alpha X and alpha Y equal. Single-cell methods that sequence the alpha and beta genes of individual T cells retain each pair and can be combined with function-related gene expression, and the same TCR sequence can sit in functionally different cells (Han 2014). A bulk method profiles a mixed sample, often one chain, whereas TIRTL-seq generates paired alpha and beta repertoire data at cohort scale and is distinguished from bulk single-chain data and from single-cell throughput limits (Pogorelyy 2026). Paired identity plus an expression program is more context and is still not evidence of the receptor's antigen.
fields.semanticStatus: Exact current-field anchor; source-to-requirement acceptance remains pending.

fields.supportingExcerpt: Frequency arithmetic, fictional: clonotype A is 10 of 10,000 sampled receptor units at baseline (0.1%) and 20 of 1,000 later (2%). The measured relative frequency rose twentyfold, but these are sampled receptor units and not a census of cells, and other populations contracting, different sampling and method effects can change frequency. Read counts are not always cell counts, because preparation, amplification and transcript abundance can change them, and absolute expansion needs compatible cell-number evidence. A sequence overlap between blood and tumour is detected overlap under a clonotype definition and is not a target, and antigen specificity needs a matching controlled recognition experiment.
fields.semanticStatus: Exact current-field anchor; source-to-requirement acceptance remains pending.

fields.supportingExcerpt: Assay card: measures receptor identities, usually by the complementarity-determining region 3 of the variable region, and their measured representation in the sampled population. How: extract nucleic acid, amplify or capture receptor regions, sequence, then group and count under stated rules, which may use nucleotide or amino-acid sequence, gene segments, one chain or paired chains. Input: blood cells or tissue nucleic acid for bulk methods and compatible cell preparations for single-cell methods, and preparation consumes material. A high-resolution human repertoire method reported chain diversity without sequence-associated or quantitative restrictions (Ruggiero 2015). Failure modes: poor material, shallow sampling, amplification bias, chain mismatch, inconsistent definitions and batch effects. It cannot tell every receptor's target, tissue position, killing or benefit, and a research method is not automatically a treatment-selection test.
fields.semanticStatus: Exact current-field anchor; source-to-requirement acceptance remains pending.

fields.supportingExcerpt: Repertoire measures describe how many receptor identities are sampled and how unevenly they are represented. A dominant sequence does not tell us what its cells recognize.
fields.semanticStatus: Exact current-field anchor; source-to-requirement acceptance remains pending.

fields.supportingExcerpt: Repertoire sequencing can describe richness and the distribution of sampled receptor sequences. Those summaries depend on the sampled population and the way receptor identities and counts are defined; the original sequencing study found diversity estimates that differed from earlier methods. A repertoire dominated by a clone is a distributional observation. It is distinct from proving tumor specificity, a malignant clone or successful tumor killing, each of which needs additional evidence.
fields.semanticStatus: Exact current-field anchor; source-to-requirement acceptance remains pending.

fields.supportingExcerpt: The repertoire is a distribution of receptor identities and abundances in a stated population and time. A clone is a cellular lineage; a clonotype is an operational sequence grouping. Single-chain labels and paired identities have different resolution. V(D)J assembly and thymic selection contribute diversity, while expansion changes abundance; diversity and total T-cell count are different quantities.
fields.semanticStatus: Exact current-field anchor; source-to-requirement acceptance remains pending.

fields.supportingExcerpt: Blood, tumour and lymph nodes sample overlapping but different populations. Infection, therapy, age and movement can change a sample; absence from one tube may reflect sampling or detection rather than whole-body absence. A pretreatment blood sample is not a complete stored repertoire. Lower measured diversity after infection may reflect a vigorous response and does not establish cancer specificity, vaccine causation or uniformly worse immunity.
fields.semanticStatus: Exact current-field anchor; source-to-requirement acceptance remains pending.

fields.supportingExcerpt: Fictional matched receptor samples contain 10 clonotype A cells among 1,000 T cells (1%) and 10 among 100 (10%). The sampled count remains 10; the changed denominator drives the larger fraction. Absolute expansion requires comparable sampling and calibrated counts, and neither frequency identifies antigen. State sampling depth, chain definition, compartment, method and timing.
fields.semanticStatus: Exact current-field anchor; source-to-requirement acceptance remains pending.

fields.supportingExcerpt: Metrics and arithmetic, fictional: with natural logarithms Shannon entropy is H = minus the sum of p times ln p, and one normalised clonality convention is 1 minus H / ln K for K observed clonotypes greater than one. Four clonotypes at 25, 25, 25 and 25 of 100 measured molecules give H = ln 4 = 1.386 and clonality 0. The same four at 70, 10, 10 and 10 give H = 0.940, clonality 1 minus 0.940 / 1.386 = 0.32, and an effective number of clonotypes exp(H) = 2.56. Richness is four in both, so many identities can coexist with strong dominance. Software may report Shannon entropy, its exponential or a normalised score, and these are not interchangeable: in the VDJtools documentation the Shannon-Wiener index returns the exponent of the entropy and the normalised index returns the entropy divided by the log of the clonotype count, which is evenness and not 1 minus that ratio, so a clonality built as 1 minus normalised entropy is a different number from either.
fields.semanticStatus: Exact current-field anchor; source-to-requirement acceptance remains pending.

fields.supportingExcerpt: Share against count, fictional: clonotype A is 30 of 100 measured molecules, 30%, and later 30 of 50, 60%. Its measured count did not rise, the total fell, and its relative frequency doubled, so relative enrichment is not absolute expansion and the molecule counts are not blood cell counts. In a published analysis pipeline, clonality was identified as a robust key metric and first choice for measuring TCR repertoire diversity, and in prostate cancer patients given sipuleucel-T the pipeline detected changes in sequence frequency and diversity in blood and prostate tissue (Zhang 2017); that is a methods and example study and sets no response threshold. A diversity-analysis software suite reports repertoire comparison and diversity outputs (Shugay 2015), and formulas, software settings and subsampling depth have to be stated.
fields.semanticStatus: Exact current-field anchor; source-to-requirement acceptance remains pending.

fields.supportingExcerpt: Measurement card: input is a sequencing-derived clonotype table and the calculation consumes no further tissue, though the upstream assay consumes its sample. Output units are a count for richness, dimensionless values for entropy and normalised clonality, and an effective clonotype count for effective diversity. Controls are matched compartments and handling, chain definition, error filtering, abundance units (reads, corrected molecules or cells are not automatically equivalent), depth assessment and replicates or resampling. Subsampling to a comparable depth helps assess sampling effects but cannot recover cells never sampled. A clonality summary does not identify what the receptors recognise, whether cells killed tumour, or whether treatment helped, and there is no universal clonality score that means an immune therapy is working.
fields.semanticStatus: Exact current-field anchor; source-to-requirement acceptance remains pending.

fields.supportingExcerpt: These experiments measure whether immune cells cause death of specified target cells. The target cells, comparison conditions and timing are part of the result.
fields.semanticStatus: Exact current-field anchor; source-to-requirement acceptance remains pending.

fields.supportingExcerpt: A primary flow-cytometry method distinguished labeled target cells from immune effector cells and measured target death while characterizing the effector population. The study examined how timing and the effector-to-target ratio affected the assay. Degranulation markers provide a related functional readout, but they measure a step preceding cytolysis. Killing of a laboratory target does not establish recognition of every tumor cell or benefit in the person receiving a treatment.
fields.semanticStatus: Exact current-field anchor; source-to-requirement acceptance remains pending.

fields.supportingExcerpt: Method card, what it measures: whether specified effector cells cause death of specified target cells under controlled laboratory conditions, at a stated effector-to-target ratio and time. Readouts: flow cytometry that separates labelled targets from effectors and uses death-associated staining, release assays, or imaging over time. A fall in a metabolic or growth signal can reflect slowed growth and not death, so it needs validation as evidence of killing. Controls: target-only survival wells, effector identification and viability, a positive-control response, irrelevant or antigen-negative targets and suitable antigen or presentation perturbations, plus maximum release where relevant. Failure modes: high spontaneous death, mistaken target identity, aggregates, dye transfer, artificial loading, mismatched ratios or a readout that mainly measures growth.
fields.semanticStatus: Exact current-field anchor; source-to-requirement acceptance remains pending.

fields.supportingExcerpt: Background arithmetic, fictional: matched wells of 100 identifiable targets show 30% death without effectors and 40% with them at the same 2-hour endpoint. Raw death is 40%, but 30% occurs without effectors, so the excess is 40 minus 30 = 10 percentage points. That excess is associated with the tested condition and does not identify which deaths the effectors caused, and calling the result 40% immune killing is not justified. A control-normalised specific-lysis formula gives a different quantity from an excess-death calculation, so the method has to be named, and a high baseline death can make the experiment unsuitable.
fields.semanticStatus: Exact current-field anchor; source-to-requirement acceptance remains pending.

fields.supportingExcerpt: Scope of the methods: a flow-based assay labels targets with a dye, adds a dead-cell stain and analyses released nuclei, which lowers errors from target-effector aggregates, and it reported four nuclear staining patterns separating target and effector nuclei and live and dead cells (Rabinovich 2019). A peptide-pulsed target assay compares CFSE-low peptide-loaded and CFSE-high unloaded CD4 T-cell targets and calculates lytic units from specific lysis at several ratios (Noto 2013), so its result belongs to that artificial peptide loading, which can bypass the tumour's own processing. Degranulation (CD107 exposure) preceded cytolysis and was concordant with interferon gamma in the original report, and is distinct from completed target death (Betts 2003). Model-specific killing does not show trafficking, persistence, healthy-tissue safety or patient benefit.
fields.semanticStatus: Exact current-field anchor; source-to-requirement acceptance remains pending.

decisions.name: cfDNA fragmentomics (de)
decisions.text: Die Fragmentomik liest die Größe und Position von DNA-Fragmenten im Blut, nicht die Mutationen. Krebszellen sterben unordentlich ab und hinterlassen ein erkennbares Fragmentierungsmuster.
decisions.after: Die Fragmentomik liest die Größe und Position von DNA-Fragmenten im Blut, nicht die Mutationen. Krebszellen sterben unordentlich ab und hinterlassen ein erkennbares Fragmentierungsmuster.

decisions.name: Minimal / molecular residual disease (MRD) (de)
decisions.text: Krebs, der nach der Behandlung noch vorhanden, aber zu klein ist, um in Bildgebungsuntersuchungen sichtbar zu sein, und der durch Blut- oder Knochenmarktests nachgewiesen wird.

decisions.name: MRD / molecular residual disease testing (de)
decisions.text: Ein hochempfindlicher Bluttest nach der Operation, der verbliebenen Krebs Monate früher nachweist, als es eine Bildgebung könnte.
decisions.after: Ein hochempfindlicher Bluttest nach der Operation, der verbliebenen Krebs Monate früher nachweist, als es eine Bildgebung könnte.

decisions.name: Intravasation & circulating tumour cells (de)
decisions.text: Der Eintritt in die Blutbahn tötet fast jede Zelle, die es versucht: Die Zellen werden von ihren Nachbarn gerissen, vom Blutstrom geschüttelt und von NK-Zellen gejagt. Weniger als eine von tausend überlebt. Die Überlebenden reisen in Gruppen, tragen einen Mantel aus Blutplättchen oder heften sich an Neutrophile. Liquid Biopsies fangen ab, was übrig bleibt.
decisions.after: Der Eintritt in die Blutbahn tötet fast jede Zelle, die es versucht: Die Zellen werden von ihren Nachbarn gerissen, vom Blutstrom geschüttelt und von NK-Zellen gejagt. Weniger als eine von tausend überlebt. Die Überlebenden reisen in Gruppen, tragen einen Mantel aus Blutplättchen oder heften sich an Neutrophile. Liquid Biopsies fangen ab, was übrig bleibt.

decisions.name: Flow cytometry (immunophenotyping) (de)
decisions.text: Ein Gerät, das Zellen einzeln an Lasern vorbeiströmen lässt und die Oberflächenproteine (CD-Marker) jeder Zelle abliest, um zu bestimmen, um welche Zellart es sich handelt. So werden Leukämien und Lymphome typisiert und wird die Resterkrankung gezählt.
decisions.after: Ein Gerät, das Zellen einzeln an Lasern vorbeiströmen lässt und die Oberflächenproteine (CD-Marker) jeder Zelle abliest, um zu bestimmen, um welche Zellart es sich handelt. So werden Leukämien und Lymphome typisiert und wird die Resterkrankung gezählt.

decisions.name: Cell-free DNA (cfDNA) (es)
decisions.text: Fragmentos cortos de ADN que flotan en la sangre, liberados por células que mueren en todo el cuerpo. La mayor parte procede de células normales; la pequeña fracción derivada del tumor (ctDNA) es lo que las biopsias líquidas pescan.
decisions.after: Fragmentos cortos de ADN que flotan en la sangre, liberados por células que mueren en todo el cuerpo. La mayor parte procede de células normales; la pequeña fracción derivada del tumor (ctDNA) es lo que las biopsias líquidas pescan.

decisions.name: Circulating tumour DNA (ctDNA) (es)
decisions.text: Fragmentos de ADN liberados por las células tumorales a la sangre, detectables con secuenciación sensible.
decisions.after: Fragmentos de ADN liberados por las células tumorales a la sangre, detectables con secuenciación sensible.

decisions.name: Clonal haematopoiesis (CHIP) (es)
decisions.text: Con la edad, en la mayoría de las personas se expanden silenciosamente células madre de la sangre con mutaciones similares a las del cáncer. Estos clones aumentan el riesgo de leucemia y de enfermedad cardíaca, se aceleran con la quimioterapia y confunden los análisis de sangre que buscan ADN del cáncer.

decisions.name: Continuous and near-continuous ctDNA monitoring (es)
decisions.text: En lugar de analizar la sangre cada tres meses, tomar muestras de forma constante, de modo que una recaída se detecte la misma semana en que empieza.
decisions.after: En lugar de analizar la sangre cada tres meses, tomar muestras de forma constante, de modo que una recaída se detecte la misma semana en que empieza.

decisions.name: cfDNA fragmentomics (es)
decisions.text: Leer los tamaños y posiciones de los fragmentos de ADN en la sangre, no las mutaciones. Las células cancerosas mueren de forma desordenada y dejan un patrón reconocible.
decisions.after: Leer los tamaños y posiciones de los fragmentos de ADN en la sangre, no las mutaciones. Las células cancerosas mueren de forma desordenada y dejan un patrón reconocible.

decisions.name: Minimal / molecular residual disease (MRD) (es)
decisions.text: Cáncer aún presente tras el tratamiento pero demasiado pequeño para verse en las exploraciones, detectado por pruebas de sangre o médula.

decisions.name: MRD / molecular residual disease testing (es)
decisions.text: Un análisis de sangre ultrasensible tras la cirugía que detecta cáncer residual meses antes que una exploración.
decisions.after: Un análisis de sangre ultrasensible tras la cirugía que detecta cáncer residual meses antes que una exploración.

decisions.name: Intravasation & circulating tumour cells (es)
decisions.text: Entrar en el torrente sanguíneo mata a casi todas las células que lo intentan: las células son arrancadas de sus vecinas, golpeadas por el flujo y cazadas por las células NK. Menos de una de cada mil sobrevive. Las que lo logran viajan en grupos, se cubren con un manto de plaquetas o van acompañadas de neutrófilos. Las biopsias líquidas capturan lo que queda.
decisions.after: Entrar en el torrente sanguíneo mata a casi todas las células que lo intentan: las células son arrancadas de sus vecinas, golpeadas por el flujo y cazadas por las células NK. decisions.name: Flow cytometry (immunophenotyping) (es)
decisions.text: Una máquina que hace pasar las células una a una frente a láseres y lee las proteínas de superficie (marcadores CD) que cada una lleva, identificando qué tipo de célula es. Así se tipifican las leucemias y los linfomas y así se cuenta la enfermedad residual.

decisions.name: Cell-free DNA (cfDNA) (fr)
decisions.text: De courts fragments d'ADN flottant dans le sang, libérés par les cellules qui meurent dans tout le corps. La plupart proviennent de cellules normales ; la petite fraction issue de la tumeur (ctDNA) est ce que les biopsies liquides vont pêcher.
decisions.after: De courts fragments d'ADN flottant dans le sang, libérés par les cellules qui meurent dans tout le corps. La plupart proviennent de cellules normales ; la petite fraction issue de la tumeur (ctDNA) est ce que les biopsies liquides vont pêcher.

decisions.name: Circulating tumour DNA (ctDNA) (fr)
decisions.text: L'ADN tumoral circulant (ctDNA) est constitué de fragments d'ADN libérés par les cellules tumorales dans le sang, détectables par un séquençage sensible.
decisions.after: L'ADN tumoral circulant (ctDNA) est constitué de fragments d'ADN libérés par les cellules tumorales dans le sang, détectables par un séquençage sensible.

decisions.name: Clonal haematopoiesis (CHIP) (fr)
decisions.text: Avec l'âge, des cellules souches du sang porteuses de mutations de type cancéreux se multiplient discrètement chez la plupart des gens. Ces clones augmentent le risque de leucémie et de maladie cardiaque, sont accélérés par la chimiothérapie et brouillent les tests sanguins recherchant l'ADN du cancer.

decisions.name: Continuous and near-continuous ctDNA monitoring (fr)
decisions.text: Plutôt que d'analyser le sang tous les trois mois, prélever des échantillons en continu, afin de détecter une rechute la semaine même où elle commence.
decisions.after: Plutôt que d'analyser le sang tous les trois mois, prélever des échantillons en continu, afin de détecter une rechute la semaine même où elle commence.

decisions.name: cfDNA fragmentomics (fr)
decisions.text: La fragmentomique analyse la taille et la position des fragments d'ADN dans le sang, et non les mutations. Les cellules cancéreuses meurent de façon désordonnée et laissent un schéma de fragmentation reconnaissable.
decisions.after: La fragmentomique analyse la taille et la position des fragments d'ADN dans le sang, et non les mutations. Les cellules cancéreuses meurent de façon désordonnée et laissent un schéma de fragmentation reconnaissable.

decisions.name: Minimal / molecular residual disease (MRD) (fr)
decisions.text: Un cancer encore présent après le traitement mais trop petit pour être visible à l'imagerie, détecté par des analyses de sang ou de moelle osseuse.

decisions.name: MRD / molecular residual disease testing (fr)
decisions.text: Une analyse de sang ultrasensible réalisée après la chirurgie, qui détecte le cancer résiduel des mois avant qu'une imagerie ne le fasse.
decisions.after: Une analyse de sang ultrasensible réalisée après la chirurgie, qui détecte le cancer résiduel des mois avant qu'une imagerie ne le fasse.

decisions.name: Intravasation & circulating tumour cells (fr)
decisions.text: Entrer dans la circulation sanguine tue presque toutes les cellules qui s'y risquent : les cellules sont arrachées à leurs voisines, malmenées par le flux et traquées par les cellules NK. Moins d'une sur mille survit. Celles qui y parviennent voyagent en grappes, se couvrent d'un manteau de plaquettes ou s'accrochent aux neutrophiles. Les biopsies liquides capturent ce qui reste.
decisions.after: Entrer dans la circulation sanguine tue presque toutes les cellules qui s'y risquent : les cellules sont arrachées à leurs voisines, malmenées par le flux et traquées par les cellules NK. Moins d'une sur mille survit. Celles qui y parviennent voyagent en grappes, se couvrent d'un manteau de plaquettes ou s'accrochent aux neutrophiles. Les biopsies liquides capturent ce qui reste.

decisions.name: Flow cytometry (immunophenotyping) (fr)
decisions.text: Un appareil qui fait défiler les cellules une à une devant des lasers et lit les protéines de surface (marqueurs CD) que chacune porte, afin d'identifier de quel type de cellule il s'agit. C'est ainsi que l'on classe les leucémies et les lymphomes et que l'on mesure la maladie résiduelle.
decisions.after: Un appareil qui fait défiler les cellules une à une devant des lasers et lit les protéines de surface (marqueurs CD) que chacune porte, afin d'identifier de quel type de cellule il s'agit. C'est ainsi que l'on classe les leucémies et les lymphomes et que l'on mesure la maladie résiduelle.

decisions.name: Cell-free DNA (cfDNA) (hi)
decisions.text: रक्त में तैरते DNA के छोटे टुकड़े, जो पूरे शरीर में मरती कोशिकाओं से निकलते हैं। इनमें से अधिकतर सामान्य कोशिकाओं से आते हैं; ट्यूमर से निकला छोटा हिस्सा (ctDNA) ही वह है जिसे लिक्विड बायोप्सी पकड़ती है।
decisions.after: रक्त में तैरते DNA के छोटे टुकड़े, जो पूरे शरीर में मरती कोशिकाओं से निकलते हैं। इनमें से अधिकतर सामान्य कोशिकाओं से आते हैं; ट्यूमर से निकला छोटा हिस्सा (ctDNA) ही वह है जिसे लिक्विड बायोप्सी पकड़ती है।

decisions.name: Circulating tumour DNA (ctDNA) (hi)
decisions.text: ट्यूमर कोशिकाओं द्वारा रक्त में छोड़े DNA टुकड़े, संवेदी अनुक्रमण से पकड़ने योग्य।
decisions.after: ट्यूमर कोशिकाओं द्वारा रक्त में छोड़े DNA टुकड़े, संवेदी अनुक्रमण से पकड़ने योग्य।

decisions.name: Clonal haematopoiesis (CHIP) (hi)
decisions.text: उम्र बढ़ने के साथ, ज़्यादातर लोगों में कैंसर जैसे उत्परिवर्तन वाली रक्त स्टेम कोशिकाएँ चुपचाप बढ़ती जाती हैं। ये क्लोन ल्यूकेमिया और हृदय रोग का जोखिम बढ़ाते हैं, कीमोथेरेपी से और तेज़ हो जाते हैं, और कैंसर DNA की रक्त जाँचों को भ्रमित करते हैं।

decisions.name: Continuous and near-continuous ctDNA monitoring (hi)
decisions.text: हर तीन महीने में रक्त की जांच करने के बजाय लगातार नमूने लेना, ताकि पुनरावृत्ति उसी सप्ताह पकड़ में आ जाए जिसमें वह शुरू होती है।
decisions.after: हर तीन महीने में रक्त की जांच करने के बजाय लगातार नमूने लेना, ताकि पुनरावृत्ति उसी सप्ताह पकड़ में आ जाए जिसमें वह शुरू होती है।

decisions.name: cfDNA fragmentomics (hi)
decisions.text: रक्त में DNA टुकड़ों के आकार और स्थान पढ़ना, म्यूटेशन नहीं। कैंसर कोशिकाएँ अव्यवस्थित रूप से मरती हैं और पहचानने योग्य विखंडन पैटर्न छोड़ती हैं।
decisions.after: रक्त में DNA टुकड़ों के आकार और स्थान पढ़ना, म्यूटेशन नहीं। कैंसर कोशिकाएँ अव्यवस्थित रूप से मरती हैं और पहचानने योग्य विखंडन पैटर्न छोड़ती हैं।

decisions.name: Minimal / molecular residual disease (MRD) (hi)
decisions.text: उपचार के बाद मौजूद पर स्कैन में दिखने के लिए बहुत छोटा कैंसर, रक्त या मज्जा जाँच से पकड़ा।

decisions.name: MRD / molecular residual disease testing (hi)
decisions.text: सर्जरी के बाद अति-संवेदी रक्त जाँच जो स्कैन से महीनों पहले बचा कैंसर पकड़ती है।
decisions.after: सर्जरी के बाद अति-संवेदी रक्त जाँच जो स्कैन से महीनों पहले बचा कैंसर पकड़ती है।

decisions.name: Intravasation & circulating tumour cells (hi)
decisions.text: रक्तप्रवाह में पहुंचना और वहां जीवित रहना बहुत कठिन है: कोशिकाएं अपनी पड़ोसी कोशिकाओं से अलग कर दी जाती हैं, रक्त के बहाव से पिटती हैं और NK कोशिकाओं द्वारा शिकार की जाती हैं। हज़ार में से एक से भी कम जीवित बचती हैं। जो बचती हैं, वे समूहों में यात्रा करती हैं, प्लेटलेट्स का आवरण पहनती हैं, या न्यूट्रोफिल के साथ चलती हैं। लिक्विड बायोप्सी जो बचता है उसे पकड़ती है।

decisions.name: Flow cytometry (immunophenotyping) (hi)
decisions.text: एक मशीन जो कोशिकाओं को एक-एक करके लेज़र के सामने से गुज़ारती है और हर कोशिका पर मौजूद सतह प्रोटीन (CD मार्कर) पढ़ती है, यह पहचानते हुए कि वह किस प्रकार की कोशिका है। इसी से ल्यूकेमिया और लिम्फोमा का प्रकार तय होता है और अवशिष्ट रोग की गिनती होती है।

decisions.name: Cell-free DNA (cfDNA) (ja)
decisions.text: 血液中を漂う短いDNAの断片であり、全身の死んでいく細胞から放出される。大部分は正常細胞由来であり、腫瘍由来のごく一部（ctDNA）こそがリキッドバイオプシーの拾い上げる対象である。
decisions.after: 血液中を漂う短いDNAの断片であり、全身の死んでいく細胞から放出される。大部分は正常細胞由来であり、腫瘍由来のごく一部（ctDNA）こそがリキッドバイオプシーの拾い上げる対象である。

decisions.name: Circulating tumour DNA (ctDNA) (ja)
decisions.text: 血中循環腫瘍DNA（ctDNA）は、腫瘍細胞から血液中に放出されたDNAの断片で、高感度のシーケンシングで検出できます。
decisions.after: 血中循環腫瘍DNA（ctDNA）は、腫瘍細胞から血液中に放出されたDNAの断片で、高感度のシーケンシングで検出できます。

decisions.name: Clonal haematopoiesis (CHIP) (ja)
decisions.text: 加齢とともに、がんに似た変異を持つ血液幹細胞が、ほとんどの人で静かに増えていく。これらのクローンは白血病と心疾患のリスクを高め、化学療法によって加速し、がんDNAを調べる血液検査を混乱させる。

decisions.name: Continuous and near-continuous ctDNA monitoring (ja)
decisions.text: 3か月ごとに血液を検査するのではなく、絶えず採取を続けることで、再発が始まったその週に捉える。
decisions.after: 3か月ごとに血液を検査するのではなく、絶えず採取を続けることで、再発が始まったその週に捉える。

decisions.name: cfDNA fragmentomics (ja)
decisions.text: フラグメントミクスは、血液中のDNA断片の大きさと位置を読み取るもので、変異を読むわけではない。がん細胞は乱雑に死ぬため、見分けやすい断片化パターンを残す。
decisions.after: フラグメントミクスは、血液中のDNA断片の大きさと位置を読み取るもので、変異を読むわけではない。がん細胞は乱雑に死ぬため、見分けやすい断片化パターンを残す。

decisions.name: Minimal / molecular residual disease (MRD) (ja)
decisions.text: 治療後もなお残っているが、画像検査では見えないほど小さいがんのことで、血液検査や骨髄検査で検出される。

decisions.name: MRD / molecular residual disease testing (ja)
decisions.text: 手術後に行う超高感度の血液検査で、画像検査より何か月も早く残ったがんを見つけ出す。
decisions.after: 手術後に行う超高感度の血液検査で、画像検査より何か月も早く残ったがんを見つけ出す。

decisions.text: 血流に入った細胞のほとんどは生き残れない。細胞は隣の細胞から引き剥がされ、血流に叩かれ、NK細胞に追われる。生き残るのは1000個に1個にも満たない。生き残った細胞は集団で移動し、血小板の「マント」をまとい、あるいは好中球と一緒に運ばれる。リキッドバイオプシーはその残った細胞を捉える。
decisions.after: 血流に入った細胞のほとんどは生き残れない。細胞は隣の細胞から引き剥がされ、血流に叩かれ、NK細胞に追われる。生き残るのは1000個に1個にも満たない。生き残った細胞は集団で移動し、血小板の「マント」をまとい、あるいは好中球と一緒に運ばれる。リキッドバイオプシーはその残った細胞を捉える。

decisions.name: Flow cytometry (immunophenotyping) (ja)
decisions.text: 細胞を1個ずつレーザーの前に流し、それぞれが持つ表面タンパク質（CDマーカー）を読み取って、どの種類の細胞かを判別する装置。白血病やリンパ腫の分類や、残存病変の測定はこの方法で行われる。
decisions.after: 細胞を1個ずつレーザーの前に流し、それぞれが持つ表面タンパク質（CDマーカー）を読み取って、どの種類の細胞かを判別する装置。白血病やリンパ腫の分類や、残存病変の測定はこの方法で行われる。

decisions.name: Cell-free DNA (cfDNA) (pt)
decisions.text: Pedaços curtos de DNA que flutuam no sangue, liberados por células que morrem em todo o corpo. A maior parte vem de células normais; a pequena fração derivada do tumor (ctDNA) é o que as biópsias líquidas pescam.
decisions.after: Pedaços curtos de DNA que flutuam no sangue, liberados por células que morrem em todo o corpo. A maior parte vem de células normais; a pequena fração derivada do tumor (ctDNA) é o que as biópsias líquidas pescam.

decisions.name: Circulating tumour DNA (ctDNA) (pt)
decisions.text: Fragmentos de DNA liberados por células tumorais no sangue, detectáveis com sequenciamento sensível.
decisions.after: Fragmentos de DNA liberados por células tumorais no sangue, detectáveis com sequenciamento sensível.

decisions.name: Clonal haematopoiesis (CHIP) (pt)
decisions.text: Com a idade, células-tronco do sangue com mutações semelhantes às do câncer se expandem silenciosamente na maioria das pessoas. Esses clones aumentam o risco de leucemia e de doença cardíaca, são acelerados pela quimioterapia e confundem os exames de sangue que procuram DNA de câncer.

decisions.name: Continuous and near-continuous ctDNA monitoring (pt)
decisions.text: Em vez de testar o sangue a cada três meses, coletar amostras constantemente, para que uma recidiva seja detectada na semana em que começa.
decisions.after: Em vez de testar o sangue a cada três meses, coletar amostras constantemente, para que uma recidiva seja detectada na semana em que começa.

decisions.name: cfDNA fragmentomics (pt)
decisions.text: Ler os tamanhos e posições dos fragmentos de DNA no sangue, não as mutações. Células cancerosas morrem de forma desordenada e deixam um padrão reconhecível.
decisions.after: Ler os tamanhos e posições dos fragmentos de DNA no sangue, não as mutações. Células cancerosas morrem de forma desordenada e deixam um padrão reconhecível.

decisions.name: Minimal / molecular residual disease (MRD) (pt)
decisions.text: Câncer ainda presente após o tratamento, mas pequeno demais para ser visto em exames, detectado por testes de sangue ou medula.

decisions.name: MRD / molecular residual disease testing (pt)
decisions.text: Um exame de sangue ultrassensível após a cirurgia que detecta câncer residual meses antes de um exame de imagem.
decisions.after: Um exame de sangue ultrassensível após a cirurgia que detecta câncer residual meses antes de um exame de imagem.

decisions.name: Intravasation & circulating tumour cells (pt)
decisions.text: Entrar na corrente sanguínea mata quase todas as células que tentam: as células são arrancadas de suas vizinhas, golpeadas pelo fluxo e caçadas por células NK. Menos de uma em mil sobrevive. As que sobrevivem viajam em grupos, vestem um manto de plaquetas ou seguem acompanhadas de neutrófilos. As biópsias líquidas capturam o que sobra.
decisions.after: Entrar na corrente sanguínea mata quase todas as células que tentam: as células são arrancadas de suas vizinhas, golpeadas pelo fluxo e caçadas por células NK. Menos de uma em mil sobrevive. As que sobrevivem viajam em grupos, vestem um manto de plaquetas ou seguem acompanhadas de neutrófilos. As biópsias líquidas capturam o que sobra.

decisions.name: Flow cytometry (immunophenotyping) (pt)
decisions.text: Uma máquina que faz passar as células uma a uma diante de lasers e lê as proteínas de superfície (marcadores CD) que cada uma transporta, identificando que tipo de célula é. É assim que as leucemias e os linfomas são tipificados e que a doença residual é contada.
decisions.after: Uma máquina que faz passar as células uma a uma diante de lasers e lê as proteínas de superfície (marcadores CD) que cada uma transporta, identificando que tipo de célula é. É assim que as leucemias e os linfomas são tipificados e que a doença residual é contada.

decisions.name: Cell-free DNA (cfDNA) (zh)
decisions.text: 漂浮在血液中的短DNA片段，由全身各处死亡的细胞释放。大部分来自正常细胞；其中来源于肿瘤的一小部分（ctDNA）正是液体活检要捕捞的对象。
decisions.after: 漂浮在血液中的短DNA片段，由全身各处死亡的细胞释放。大部分来自正常细胞；其中来源于肿瘤的一小部分（ctDNA）正是液体活检要捕捞的对象。

decisions.name: Circulating tumour DNA (ctDNA) (zh)
decisions.text: 肿瘤细胞脱落到血液中的DNA片段，可用敏感测序检测。
decisions.after: 肿瘤细胞脱落到血液中的DNA片段，可用敏感测序检测。

decisions.name: Clonal haematopoiesis (CHIP) (zh)
decisions.text: 随着年龄增长，大多数人体内带有癌症样突变的血液干细胞会悄悄扩增。这些克隆会提高白血病和心脏病的风险，会被化疗加速，并且会干扰检测癌症DNA的血液检查。

decisions.name: Circulating tumour cell capture (zh)
decisions.text: 从血样中“钓出”完整癌细胞进行计数或研究；其数量在乳腺癌、前列腺癌和结直肠癌中具有预后意义。
decisions.after: 从血样中“钓出”完整癌细胞进行计数或研究；其数量在乳腺癌、前列腺癌和结直肠癌中具有预后意义。

decisions.name: CellSearch circulating tumour cell count (zh)
decisions.text: 唯一获监管机构批准的计数完整癌细胞的血液检测；一小管血中有五个以上细胞，提示转移性乳腺癌、前列腺癌和肠癌预后较差，但仅凭计数更换治疗并未让患者获益。

decisions.name: Parsortix label-free circulating tumour cell harvest (zh)
decisions.text: 一种微流控盒，按细胞大小和硬度而非表面标志物从血液中截留癌细胞，再将其完整释放供检测；是美国首个获批的此类装置，用于转移性乳腺癌。
decisions.after: 一种微流控盒，按细胞大小和硬度而非表面标志物从血液中截留癌细胞，再将其完整释放供检测；是美国首个获批的此类装置，用于转移性乳腺癌。

decisions.name: Continuous and near-continuous ctDNA monitoring (zh)
decisions.text: 不再每三个月检测一次血液，而是持续采样，让复发在开始的那一周就被发现。
decisions.after: 不再每三个月检测一次血液，而是持续采样，让复发在开始的那一周就被发现。

decisions.name: cfDNA fragmentomics (zh)
decisions.text: 读取血液中DNA片段的大小和位置而非突变。癌细胞死得杂乱，留下可识别的碎片模式。
decisions.after: 读取血液中DNA片段的大小和位置而非突变。癌细胞死得杂乱，留下可识别的碎片模式。

decisions.name: Cell-free DNA methylation tests (zh)
decisions.text: 读取肿瘤脱落DNA片段上化学标记的血液检测；这些标记可区分癌症DNA与正常DNA，并提示癌症所在部位。
decisions.after: 读取肿瘤脱落DNA片段上化学标记的血液检测；这些标记可区分癌症DNA与正常DNA，并提示癌症所在部位。

decisions.name: Minimal / molecular residual disease (MRD) (zh)
decisions.text: 治疗后仍存在但影像上看不到的癌症，通过血液或骨髓检测发现。

decisions.name: MRD / molecular residual disease testing (zh)
decisions.text: 术后的超敏血液检测，比影像早数月发现残留癌症。
decisions.after: 术后的超敏血液检测，比影像早数月发现残留癌症。

decisions.name: Tumour-informed versus tumour-naive ctDNA assays (zh)
decisions.text: 肿瘤知情型血液检测为一位患者专门定制：先测肿瘤序列，再在血液中寻找该患者自己的突变。肿瘤非知情型检测对所有人用同一套固定组合（常为甲基化标记），不需要肿瘤样本，出结果更快。
decisions.after: 肿瘤知情型血液检测为一位患者专门定制：先测肿瘤序列，再在血液中寻找该患者自己的突变。肿瘤非知情型检测对所有人用同一套固定组合（常为甲基化标记），不需要肿瘤样本，出结果更快。

decisions.name: Intravasation & circulating tumour cells (zh)
decisions.text: 进入血流的癌细胞几乎无一存活：细胞被从邻近细胞上撕离、被血流冲击，还被NK细胞追杀。存活下来的不到千分之一。能存活的细胞成群结队地移动，披着血小板的“外衣”，或者与中性粒细胞同行。液体活检捕捉的就是剩下的这些细胞。
decisions.after: 进入血流的癌细胞几乎无一存活：细胞被从邻近细胞上撕离、被血流冲击，还被NK细胞追杀。存活下来的不到千分之一。能存活的细胞成群结队地移动，披着血小板的“外衣”，或者与中性粒细胞同行。液体活检捕捉的就是剩下的这些细胞。

decisions.name: Flow cytometry (immunophenotyping) (zh)
decisions.text: 一种让细胞逐个流过激光并读取每个细胞所携带表面蛋白（CD标志物）的机器，从而识别细胞类型。白血病和淋巴瘤的分型以及残留病灶的计数都依靠它。
decisions.after: 一种让细胞逐个流过激光并读取每个细胞所携带表面蛋白（CD标志物）的机器，从而识别细胞类型。白血病和淋巴瘤的分型以及残留病灶的计数都依靠它。

decisions.name: Cell-free DNA (cfDNA) (simple)
decisions.text: Cell-free DNA is short pieces of DNA floating in the blood shed by dying cells, and the small tumour-derived fraction is what liquid biopsies fish out.
decisions.after: Cell-free DNA is short pieces of DNA floating in the blood shed by dying cells, and the small tumour-derived fraction is what liquid biopsies fish out.

decisions.name: Circulating tumour DNA (ctDNA) (simple)
decisions.text: Bits of DNA shed by tumour cells into the blood, detectable with sensitive tests.
decisions.after: Bits of DNA shed by tumour cells into the blood, detectable with sensitive tests.

decisions.name: Clonal haematopoiesis (CHIP) (simple)
decisions.text: As we age, blood stem cells with cancer-like mutations quietly expand in most people, raising leukaemia and heart disease risk and confusing blood tests that look for cancer DNA.
decisions.after: A group of blood-forming cells with acquired changes can expand. DNA from that group can appear in a blood test and needs to be distinguished from tumour DNA.

decisions.name: Circulating tumour cell capture (simple)
decisions.text: Circulating tumour cell capture fishes whole cancer cells out of a blood sample to count or study them, and the count predicts outcome in breast, prostate and colorectal cancer.
decisions.after: Circulating tumour cell capture fishes whole cancer cells out of a blood sample to count or study them, and the count predicts outcome in breast, prostate and colorectal cancer.

decisions.name: CellSearch circulating tumour cell count (simple)
decisions.text: CellSearch is the only regulator-cleared blood test that counts whole cancer cells, and five or more cells in a small tube marks a worse outlook in breast, prostate and bowel cancer.
decisions.after: A test that counts cells captured and identified under set rules in a blood sample. What the count means depends on the cancer, test and clinical question.

decisions.name: Parsortix label-free circulating tumour cell harvest (simple)
decisions.text: Parsortix is a cassette that traps cancer cells from blood by their size and stiffness, then releases them alive for testing, and was the first such device cleared in the US.
decisions.after: Parsortix is a cassette that traps cancer cells from blood by their size and stiffness, then releases them alive for testing, and was the first such device cleared in the US.

decisions.name: Continuous and near-continuous ctDNA monitoring (simple)
decisions.text: Sampling blood constantly instead of every few months, so a relapse could be caught the week it starts; not yet ready for use.
decisions.after: Taking blood samples more often could change when tumour DNA is first detected. The timing depends on the sampling schedule, and earlier detection alone does not show a survival benefit.

decisions.name: cfDNA fragmentomics (simple)
decisions.text: Reading the sizes and positions of DNA pieces in blood. Cancer cells die messily and leave a recognisable pattern.
decisions.after: Reading the sizes and positions of DNA pieces in blood. Cancer cells die messily and leave a recognisable pattern.

decisions.name: Cell-free DNA methylation tests (simple)
decisions.text: Cell-free DNA methylation tests read chemical marks on DNA fragments shed by tumours into the blood, telling cancer DNA from normal DNA and hinting at where the cancer is.
decisions.after: Cell-free DNA methylation tests read chemical marks on DNA fragments shed by tumours into the blood, telling cancer DNA from normal DNA and hinting at where the cancer is.

decisions.name: Minimal / molecular residual disease (MRD) (simple)
decisions.text: Cancer still present after treatment but too small to see on scans, found by blood or marrow tests.
decisions.after: A test for small amounts of disease after treatment. A negative result means the test found no qualifying signal in that sample; it does not prove that no cancer remains.

decisions.name: MRD / molecular residual disease testing (simple)
decisions.text: A very sensitive blood test after surgery that finds leftover cancer months before a scan could.
decisions.after: A very sensitive blood test after surgery that finds leftover cancer months before a scan could.

decisions.name: Intravasation & circulating tumour cells (simple)
decisions.text: Getting into the bloodstream kills almost every cancer cell that tries; the few survivors travel in clusters or cloaked in platelets, and blood tests catch what is left.
decisions.after: Getting into the bloodstream kills almost every cancer cell that tries; the few survivors travel in clusters or cloaked in platelets, and blood tests catch what is left.

decisions.name: Flow cytometry (immunophenotyping) (simple)
decisions.text: Flow cytometry streams cells one by one past lasers and reads the surface markers each carries, which is how leukaemias and lymphomas are typed and residual disease counted.
decisions.after: Flow cytometry streams cells one by one past lasers and reads the surface markers each carries, which is how leukaemias and lymphomas are typed and residual disease counted.

additions: An estimate of the share of DNA in a blood sample that came from the tumour. A low share can make a negative genetic test harder to interpret.
A tumour-DNA result needs its unit. A concentration, a share of all measured DNA and a yes-or-no call answer different questions.
A blood test measures material in a blood sample, while a scan measures a region of the body. Different results need their timing and limits checked before deciding what they mean.
The gap between a qualifying positive blood test and a later defined event. It depends on the study rules and sampling schedule and is not extra time added to life.
summaryDecisions.reason: The English MRD, blood-clone, tumour-fraction and cell-count definitions now state their sample and source limits. Earlier translated short definitions are retained in the before capture and current English is selected pending language review.
